svg.title: A month of uptime, and the error budget at its end.
svg.desc: Two bars, each a month held to a 99.9 percent reliability target. Nearly all of each bar is uptime. A thin slice at its end, drawn wider than scale, is the error budget. In the first bar, two incidents have eaten part of the slice and some is left, so releases go ahead. In the second, incidents have eaten all of it, so releases slow or stop until reliability recovers.
svg.text: Some budget left: releases go ahead
Budget spent: releases slow or stop
Not to scale: the budget is about 43 minutes a month
